meta.name: dev-browser
meta.description: Browser automation with persistent page state. Use when users ask to navigate websites, fill forms, take screenshots, extract web data, test web apps, or automate browser workflows. Trigger phrases include "go to [url]", "click on", "fill out the form", "take a screenshot", "scrape", "automate", "test the website", "log into", or any browser interaction request.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操作浏览器,完成打开网页、填表、截图与取数等重复流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常要在网页上重复点按、填表、登录或抓取数据
copy.tagline_en: Drive a browser automatically to open pages, fill forms, take screenshots and pull data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you repeat clicks, forms or data pulls on websites

howto.what: Claude 通过运行小段脚本控制浏览器:打开网页、点击、填表、截图、抓取数据、测试站点。页面状态会在多次脚本执行之间保留,所以能一步步做,也能把重复操作写成一段脚本一次跑完。
howto.when: 当你说“打开某网址”“点击”“填表”等,或提出任何浏览器交互、网页测试、数据抓取的请求时,它就会接管。

say.text: 打开 https://example.com,把标题和地址告诉我。
say.note: 会启动浏览器并返回页面标题与 URL。

say.text: 在 hackernews 页面上点击「new」这个链接。
say.note: 先用 ARIA 快照找到元素,再点击。

say.text: 登录之后,截一张整页截图给我看。
say.note: 页面状态保留,可以接着在同一页操作。

howto.what_en: Claude runs small scripts to drive a browser: open pages, click, fill forms, screenshot, scrape data, test sites. Page state persists between runs, so it works step by step or scripts repeated work.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "go to [url]", "click on", "fill out the form" and similar, or ask for any browser interaction.

say_en.text: Go to https://example.com and tell me the title and URL.
say_en.note: Launches a browser and reports title and URL.

say_en.text: On the hackernews page, click the "new" link.
say_en.note: Finds the element via ARIA snapshot, then clicks it.

say_en.text: Log in, then take a full-page screenshot for me.
say_en.note: Page state persists, so you can keep going.
